Before you continue

I made this for you.

I know the road behind you has not always been gentle. I know there were difficult days, moments that hurt, and things you had to carry that you never deserved to carry alone.

So I did not want to make you just a simple “I love you” page. I wanted to make you a little place where every click reminds you of one thing:

“You are loved. You are precious. And you do not have to face everything alone.”
And yes… I am still learning. I am still growing. But I don't want to be the same person I was before. I want the days ahead of us to feel softer, safer, happier and more beautiful.

When you are sad

Take a breath, pretty girl. You do not have to pretend to be okay for me. If today is heavy, let it be heavy. Rest. Cry if you need to. And remember: you are not alone in it. I am here, and I care about you more than any bad day could ever change.
🌙

When you miss me

If you miss me, look at the little hearts on this page and imagine me saying: “Come here, my pretty girl.” Distance, silence or a difficult day cannot erase what you mean to me.
🌸

When you doubt yourself

You are trying your best. I see it. I am proud of you. You do not need to become perfect to deserve love, and you do not need to prove your worth every day. Keep going at your own pace.

Read the big letter 💌
The part I really wanted you to read

For the little girl inside you.

My pretty girl,

I know your road has been long sometimes. I know there are chapters of your life that were not as gentle as they should have been. I know there were moments when you deserved comfort and maybe had to find your own strength instead.

And I want you to know that I see that little girl in you. I do not look at her and see weakness. I see someone who deserved more softness, more safety, more laughter and more reasons to believe that tomorrow could be beautiful.

I cannot go back and change what happened before. I cannot rewrite old days or erase every sadness. But I can choose what kind of person I want to be from now on.

I do not want to stay the same person I was before. I want to learn from every mistake, become gentler, listen better and make sure that the love I give you feels like love — not another weight for your heart to carry.

I want to be a safe place for you. A person who celebrates your wins, stays beside you through the difficult days and reminds you of your worth when you forget it.

And when I look at you, no matter how much you grow, I think I will always see that little girl too. The one who deserved someone to tell her, “You are precious. You are safe. You are allowed to be happy.”

So maybe I cannot give your past the childhood it deserved. But I can spend the future giving the woman you became more reasons to smile, more reasons to feel loved, and more reasons to believe that beautiful things can still come.

I am proud of you. Truly. Not because you are perfect, but because you keep trying. You are trying your best. And I hope you never underestimate how beautiful that is.

I want to see you at the top. I want to see you succeed. I want to see you proud of yourself. I want to be there for the little victories nobody else notices and the huge ones everybody celebrates.

And yes, we have had arguments. We have had moments that hurt. But I do not want our story to be a collection of those moments. I want us to make new memories that are softer than the old ones.

I do not want another girl. I want you. I want the real you — the beautiful parts, the complicated parts, the quiet days, the loud laughs, the moments when you are strong and the moments when you simply need someone beside you.

If the whole world ever feels like it is against you, I want you to remember that you have someone cheering for you. Someone who wants you happy. Someone who believes in you.

And if one day you look in the mirror and forget how special you are, come back here.

Read this again.

Because there will always be one thing I want you to remember:

“You are loved. You are precious. And you are never as alone as you think.”

My pretty girl, this is not me promising you a perfect life. It is me promising that I will keep trying to make the part of life we share more beautiful.

I love you. A lot.

Always cheering for you, ♡

One last page 🎀

A little ending — but not really

I hope you liked this little gift.

I spent days putting these little pages, messages, pictures, hearts and surprises together because I wanted to give you something that felt personal.

It may not be the biggest gift in the world. It may not be perfect. But every little part of it was made with one thought in mind:

“I want Houda to smile when she opens this.”

I hope you smiled at least once.

And I hope that whenever you come back here, you remember that someone took the time to make a whole little world just for you.

Thank you for being you, my pretty girl.

I love you a lot. ♡
